rules.statement: Courts have the discretion to allow parties to compromise their disputes after a full investigation of title, provided that the Court is satisfied that all parties entitled to interests in the land are before it and are solely entitled to it.
rules.supporting_quote: "A number of decisions of this Court have emphasized the duty of the Court to investigate title fully and not treat a partition action as an action. inter partes. The emphasis is always on the necessity to investigate title."
